StepTitle: BATTERY switch ON. Left/Right GEN switches in NORM/ON.
CoderNotes: Battery and both generator switches reached the required state; no error coded.

StepTitle: Fire test A completed with correct aural/visual indications. Fire test B completed after ~10s pause.
CoderNotes: fire_test_complete became true while fire_test_a_complete/fire_test_b_complete were internally inconsistent. Following the manual fire-test policy, raw A/B latch timing is not used for order or omission coding; no user error coded.

StepTitle: APU switch ON. APU READY light illuminated.
CoderNotes: APU start-support completion was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to RIGHT; right engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Right engine crank was performed after APU support. Ignored auto OR/SV from initial/default first-frame engine-crank state.

StepTitle: Right throttle at IDLE. Throttle moved when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Right RPM >=25% and right throttle idle evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: BLEED AIR knob rotated full clockwise back to NORM.
CoderNotes: Bleed-air knob cycle completed and ended in NORM; no error coded.

StepTitle: Light test executed with all annunciators verified.
CoderNotes: Lights test switch activity and lights_test_complete evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Left DDI shows FCS page; right DDI shows BIT page. MPCD and HUD powered.
CoderNotes: Left/right DDI, AMPCD, and HUD brightness/power actions were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: COMM1 preset 1 frequency programmed to 134.000 MHz.
CoderNotes: COMM1 134.000 MHz was not entered: final comm1_freq_134_000=false and no UFC 1-3-4-0-0-0/ENT sequence was observed. Raw COMM1_CHANNEL_NUMERIC=1 is treated as insufficient and not coded as an order error.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to LEFT; left engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Left engine crank was later performed and engine_crank_left_complete became true. Ignored auto SV from initial/default crank state.

StepTitle: Left throttle moved from OFF to IDLE when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Left RPM >=25% and left throttle not-off/idle-ready evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: INS knob set to GND (airfield) or CV (carrier).
CoderNotes: INS mode was moved to an accepted CV/GND state, but AMPCD PB19/fast-align completion was not observed; coded omission of the quick-align confirmation step.

StepTitle: Radar knob in OPR and radar power online.
CoderNotes: Radar knob never reached OPR/radar_on state; coded omission.

StepTitle: OBOGS control and FLOW switches confirmed ON.
CoderNotes: OBOGS was switched ON and obogs_ready became true. Earlier radar omission is coded on S13 and not double-counted here.

StepTitle: FCS RESET manually pressed. FCS page brought up and reviewed for faults.
CoderNotes: FCS reset button press/release was observed and fcs_reset_complete became true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Flap switch confirmed in AUTO.
CoderNotes: Flap AUTO confirmation was not satisfied; final flap_auto=false/flap_full=true. Coded omission.

StepTitle: TAKEOFF TRIM button pressed and trim set.
CoderNotes: TAKEOFF TRIM button press and takeoff_trim_set evidence were not observed; coded omission.

StepTitle: Right DDI advanced from BIT root page to the FCS-MC BIT page.
CoderNotes: Right DDI PB5 was pressed after FCS reset/display setup, so no user omission is coded from telemetry. Passive run has no VLM confirmation of the FCS-MC page transition.

StepTitle: FCS BIT final GO result reviewed on the FCS-MC page.
CoderNotes: Telemetry shows FCS BIT switch-up plus right DDI PB5 sequence and release. Final FCS-MC GO cannot be visually confirmed in passive mode, but no user omission is coded.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully extended.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe extension was observed during the four-down check; no error coded.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully retracted.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe retraction was observed and final probe_retracted=true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Launch bar extended.
CoderNotes: Launch bar extension was not observed; final launch_bar_extended=false. Coded omission, not PA, because there is no evidence of a wrong launch-bar setting action.

StepTitle: Launch bar retracted.
CoderNotes: Launch bar ended retracted/default. Because S22 extension was omitted, no separate retraction error is double-counted.

StepTitle: Arresting hook lowered.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook down movement was observed during the four-down check; no error coded.

StepTitle: Arresting hook raised.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook retraction/final hook_retracted evidence was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Pitot heat switch ON.
CoderNotes: Pitot heat remained OFF; coded omission.

StepTitle: Flap switch set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Final flap AUTO setting was not satisfied; final flap_auto=false/flap_full=true. Coded omission.

StepTitle: Parking brake released and aircraft ready to roll.
CoderNotes: Parking brake release was not observed; final parking_brake_released=false. Coded omission.

StepTitle: BINGO fuel value set to mission requirement.
CoderNotes: BINGO fuel setting was not completed; final bingo_fuel_set=false. Coded omission.

StepTitle: Standby barometric altimeter matches local elevation/QNH.
CoderNotes: Standby barometric altimeter setting was satisfied; no error coded.

StepTitle: Radar altimeter bug set to scenario-appropriate value.
CoderNotes: Radar-altimeter bug was adjusted to the scenario value and radar_altimeter_bug_set=true. Radar OPR omission remains coded only on S13.

StepTitle: Standby attitude indicator uncaged and free-moving.
CoderNotes: Standby attitude indicator uncage/free-moving evidence was not observed; coded omission.

StepTitle: Attitude source selector set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Attitude source selector ended in AUTO; no error coded.
